hero.title: Celebrate your baby's arrival with the perfect gift registry
hero.subtitle: Create your Baby Shower in minutes, list what your baby needs and share it with a link. Your guests reserve their gift without signing up and without duplicates.
hero.imageAlt: Illustration of a baby sleeping on a cloud surrounded by pastel balloons and gifts

intro.title: A platform designed for parents-to-be
intro.text: My Baby Shower brings your event details and your baby's wish list together in one place. Forget duplicate gifts, lost messages and spreadsheets: your guests see what's missing and reserve it in one click.
intro.imageAlt: Illustration of gift boxes with ribbons in pastel colors

how.title: How does it work?
how.subtitle: Four simple steps to organize your celebration.
how.step1Text: Enter the parents' names, the baby's name and the date of the Baby Shower.
how.step2Text: Add diapers, clothes, bottles or the crib, organized by category and with the quantity you need.
how.step3Text: Generate a unique link and share it by message, email or social media.
how.step4Text: Your guests choose and reserve their gift. You see who reserved what from your dashboard.

parents.title: Benefits for parents-to-be
parents.imageAlt: Illustration of a couple with a crib mobile
parents.item1Text: See in real time which gifts are available, partially reserved or complete.
parents.item2Text: Each item can be reserved until the quantity you set runs out.
parents.item3Text: See each guest's name and message, and mark gifts as delivered.
parents.item4Text: Your information is protected and only what you publish is shared.

guests.title: Benefits for guests
guests.imageAlt: Illustration of guests celebrating with balloons
guests.item1Text: All they need is the link to see the list and reserve.
guests.item2Text: They choose from what the parents actually need.
guests.item3Text: They can leave a special message for the parents-to-be.
guests.item4Text: Works on phones, tablets and computers.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.text: Create your Baby Shower for free and share it today.

footer.tagline: The sweetest way to organize your Baby Shower.
